web.description:
# The 10 Hottest Cities in the U.S.
## **The hottest cities in the U.S.**
|  |  |  |  |
|-|-|-|-|
| [Phoenix, AZ](https://www.redfin.com/city/14240/AZ/Phoenix) | 93.7°F | 75.4°F | [122°F](https://www.weather.gov/psr/ExtremeTemps) (1990) |
| [Yuma, AZ](https://www.redfin.com/city/20893/AZ/Yuma) | 92.8°F | 75.9°F | [124°F](https://www.weather.gov/psr/ExtremeTemps) (1995) |
| [Las Vegas, NV](https://www.redfin.com/city/10201/NV/Las-Vegas) | 90.8°F | 70.1°F | [120°F](https://www.npr.org/2024/07/08/nx-s1-5032849/las-vegas-hits-a-new-record-high-of-120-degrees-fahrenheit) (2024) |
| [McAllen, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/11570/TX/McAllen) | 88.5°F | 77.4°F | [111°F](https://www.valleycentral.com/news/local-news/city-of-mcallen-reaches-record-breaking-temperature-at-111-degrees/) (2023) |
| [Laredo, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/10568/TX/Laredo) | 88.0°F | 74.6°F | [115°F](https://www.lmtonline.com/news/article/laredo-texas-hottest-temperature-record-18127013.php) (1908, 1927, 1942, 1985, 2023) |
| [Brownsville, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/2776/TX/Brownsville) | 86.4°F | 76.2°F | [106°F](https://www.valleycentral.com/news/local-news/valley-cities-break-hottest-day-records/) (1984, 2023) |
| [Tucson, AZ](https://www.redfin.com/city/19459/AZ/Tucson) | 86.4°F | 69.7°F | [117°F](https://www.weather.gov/twc/TucsonMonthlyNormalExtremes) (1990) |
| [San Antonio, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/16657/TX/San-Antonio) | 85.4°F | 71.1°F | [111°F](https://www.expressnews.com/san-antonio-weather/article/high-temps-105-degrees-san-antonio-19666549.php) (2000) |
| [Austin, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin) | 85.1°F | 70.0°F | [112°F](https://www.kxan.com/weather/austins-weather-extremes-record-heat-and-cold/) (2000, 2011) |
| [Dallas, TX](https://www.redfin.com/city/30794/TX/Dallas) | 84.5°F | 68.0°F | [113°F](https://www.weather.gov/fwd/dgr8mxmn) (1980) |

If we measured instead by average annual temperature, [Honolulu](https://www.redfin.com/city/34945/HI/Honolulu) would top the list (78°F), followed by [McAllen](https://www.redfin.com/city/11570/TX/McAllen/rentals) (77.4°F) and [Miami](https://www.redfin.com/city/11458/FL/Miami) (77.4°F).
